scope: fresh independent OpenClaw broker security review findings
integration: same-branch follow-up only; controller will selectively cherry-pick after review

controls.oauthAgentBinding: models status receives the exact configured agent and mixed token/API-key or effective non-profile routes are rejected
controls.contextPreAuthLimit: GET /api/agent/context applies a coarse IP limit before Supabase authentication
controls.browserContextIsolation: token-tagged view state hides old sites immediately and only the active request generation can commit ready state
controls.engineConcurrency: availability/OAuth preflight and execution share one maxConcurrent slot with abort propagation and child-close release
controls.backendOutages: auth and site backend failures return stable 503 codes while actual invalid/forbidden outcomes remain 401/403
controls.securityOrder: coarse pre-auth limit, authentication, fine identity limit, body parsing, site validation

tdd.command: npm.cmd test -- tests/claw-chat-route.test.ts tests/openclaw-chat.test.ts tests/engine-adapter.test.ts tests/openclaw-broker-ui-context.test.ts
